## Key Insights
* SpaceX shares fell 13% to $109.21 and AMD shares declined 6% as investors prioritized AI expenditure and revenue forecasts over earnings results.
* PB Fintech reported a 92% increase in Q1FY27 net profit to ₹163 crore alongside a 40% rise in revenue, while Shopify shares increased 18% following an e-commerce revenue beat.
* Gold prices rose to $4,325 and Silver reached $63 as diplomatic negotiations involving Iran impacted market sentiment.
* The Reserve Bank of India planned a new framework to standardize interest rate rules for regulated entities to increase transparency across lending.
* DLF targeted a ₹1 lakh crore sales pipeline over 5 years, while Sterlite Technologies secured a $210 million international order for optical fibre cables.

## Macro Context
* US Treasury maintained steady coupon auction sizes to manage yield expectations.
* US employment data showed 44,000 jobs added in July.
* The Reserve Bank of India maintained current rates while raising the FY27 GDP outlook and lowering inflation forecasts.
* The US Federal Reserve maintains a 65.5% probability of a rate cut for September 2026.
